SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WORK_ORDER WO
JOIN PRODUCTION_PLAN PP ON WO.PROD_PLAN_ID = PP.PROD_PLAN_ID
JOIN ITEM I ON PP.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN LINE L ON WO.LINE_ID = L.LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, SUM(NVL(PROD_QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_PROD_QTY, SUM(NVL(LOSS_QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_LOSS_QTY FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PA ON WO.ORDER_ID = PA.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P1.ORDER_ID, P1.PROD_STATUS FROM PRODUCTION P1 JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, MAX(PROD_ID) AS PROD_ID FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PM ON P1.ORDER_ID = PM.ORDER_ID AND P1.PROD_ID = PM.PROD_ID ) LP ON WO.ORDER_ID = LP.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P2.ORDER_ID, I2.RESULT FROM INSPECTION I2 JOIN PRODUCTION P2 ON I2.PROD_ID = P2.PROD_ID JOIN ( SELECT P3.ORDER_ID, MAX(I3.INSP_ID) AS INSP_ID FROM INSPECTION I3 JOIN PRODUCTION P3 ON I3.PROD_ID = P3.PROD_ID GROUP BY P3.ORDER_ID ) IM ON P2.ORDER_ID = IM.ORDER_ID AND I2.INSP_ID = IM.INSP_ID ) LI ON WO.ORDER_ID = LI.ORDER_ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT LOT_LIST.*, ROWNUM AS RN FROM ( SELECT WO.ORDER_ID, WO.PROD_PLAN_ID, PP.ITEM_ID,
WO.PRODUCT_LOT, PP.DOC_NO AS PROD_PLAN_DOC_NO, WO.DOC_NO AS WORK_ORDER_DOC_NO,
I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME,
NVL(L.LINE_NAME, '-') AS CURRENT_PROCESS,
WO.ORDER_QTY, NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) AS PROD_QTY, NVL(PA.TOTAL_LOSS_QTY, 0) AS LOSS_QTY, GREATEST(NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) - NVL(PA.TOTAL_LOSS_QTY, 0), 0) AS GOOD_QTY,
CASE WHEN NVL(WO.ORDER_QTY, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE LEAST( 100, ROUND((NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) / WO.ORDER_QTY) * 100) ) END AS PROGRESS_RATE,
NVL(LP.PROD_STATUS, '대기') AS PROGRESS_STATUS, NVL(LI.RESULT, '-') AS INSP_RESULT,
TO_CHAR(WO.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ORDER_DATE, TO_CHAR(LP.PROD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROD_DATE, TO_CHAR(LI.INSP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INSP_DATE
FROM WORK_ORDER WO
JOIN PRODUCTION_PLAN PP ON WO.PROD_PLAN_ID = PP.PROD_PLAN_ID
JOIN ITEM I ON PP.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN LINE L ON WO.LINE_ID = L.LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, SUM(NVL(PROD_QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_PROD_QTY, SUM(NVL(LOSS_QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_LOSS_QTY FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PA ON WO.ORDER_ID = PA.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P1.ORDER_ID, P1.PROD_ID, P1.PROD_STATUS, P1.PROD_DATE, P1.DOC_NO FROM PRODUCTION P1 JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, MAX(PROD_ID) AS PROD_ID FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PM ON P1.ORDER_ID = PM.ORDER_ID AND P1.PROD_ID = PM.PROD_ID ) LP ON WO.ORDER_ID = LP.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P2.ORDER_ID, I2.INSP_ID, I2.RESULT, I2.INSP_DATE, I2.DOC_NO FROM INSPECTION I2 JOIN PRODUCTION P2 ON I2.PROD_ID = P2.PROD_ID JOIN ( SELECT P3.ORDER_ID, MAX(I3.INSP_ID) AS INSP_ID FROM INSPECTION I3 JOIN PRODUCTION P3 ON I3.PROD_ID = P3.PROD_ID GROUP BY P3.ORDER_ID ) IM ON P2.ORDER_ID = IM.ORDER_ID AND I2.INSP_ID = IM.INSP_ID ) LI ON WO.ORDER_ID = LI.ORDER_ID
ORDER BY WO.ORDER_DATE DESC, WO.ORDER_ID DESC ) LOT_LIST WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE RN >= #{startRow}

SELECT WO.ORDER_ID, WO.PROD_PLAN_ID, PP.ITEM_ID,
LP.PROD_ID, LI.INSP_ID,
WO.PRODUCT_LOT, PP.DOC_NO AS PROD_PLAN_DOC_NO, WO.DOC_NO AS WORK_ORDER_DOC_NO, LP.DOC_NO AS PROD_DOC_NO, LI.DOC_NO AS INSP_DOC_NO,
I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME,
NVL(L.LINE_NAME, '-') AS CURRENT_PROCESS,
WO.ORDER_QTY, NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) AS PROD_QTY, NVL(PA.TOTAL_LOSS_QTY, 0) AS LOSS_QTY, GREATEST(NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) - NVL(PA.TOTAL_LOSS_QTY, 0), 0) AS GOOD_QTY, NVL(LI.INSPECTION_QTY, 0) AS INSPECTION_QTY,
CASE WHEN NVL(WO.ORDER_QTY, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE LEAST( 100, ROUND((NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) / WO.ORDER_QTY) * 100) ) END AS PROGRESS_RATE,
NVL(LP.PROD_STATUS, '대기') AS PROGRESS_STATUS, NVL(LI.RESULT, '-') AS INSP_RESULT,
TO_CHAR(WO.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ORDER_DATE, TO_CHAR(LP.PROD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROD_DATE, TO_CHAR(LI.INSP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INSP_DATE,
E.ENAME, E.DEPT, WO.REMARK
FROM WORK_ORDER WO
JOIN PRODUCTION_PLAN PP ON WO.PROD_PLAN_ID = PP.PROD_PLAN_ID
JOIN ITEM I ON PP.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN LINE L ON WO.LINE_ID = L.LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, SUM(NVL(PROD_QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_PROD_QTY, SUM(NVL(LOSS_QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_LOSS_QTY FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PA ON WO.ORDER_ID = PA.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P1.ORDER_ID, P1.PROD_ID, P1.EMP_ID, P1.PROD_STATUS, P1.PROD_DATE, P1.DOC_NO FROM PRODUCTION P1 JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, MAX(PROD_ID) AS PROD_ID FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PM ON P1.ORDER_ID = PM.ORDER_ID AND P1.PROD_ID = PM.PROD_ID ) LP ON WO.ORDER_ID = LP.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN EMP E ON LP.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P2.ORDER_ID, I2.INSP_ID, I2.RESULT, I2.INSP_DATE, I2.DOC_NO, I2.INSPECTION_QTY FROM INSPECTION I2 JOIN PRODUCTION P2 ON I2.PROD_ID = P2.PROD_ID JOIN ( SELECT P3.ORDER_ID, MAX(I3.INSP_ID) AS INSP_ID FROM INSPECTION I3 JOIN PRODUCTION P3 ON I3.PROD_ID = P3.PROD_ID GROUP BY P3.ORDER_ID ) IM ON P2.ORDER_ID = IM.ORDER_ID AND I2.INSP_ID = IM.INSP_ID ) LI ON WO.ORDER_ID = LI.ORDER_ID
WHERE WO.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
